name: OU Compatibility List
about: G era cards usable in Original Era — Expanded (docs/design/SIX_WORKSTREAMS_AUDIT.md). Only status "approved" makes a card legal there ("held" cards only in a comparison test); "proposed" cards wait for the owner's review. Card records are not copied or moved: an entry only names a card id.
